title: cascade-sidecar-checklist-and-quiet-window-index-2025-11.json
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact pocket guide for small-to-medium rollouts that rely on a sidecar cascade + quiet-window pattern. Aim is to reduce blast radius during model routing changes and to capture quick release notes that product/pm and support can copy-paste.

Context and rationale:
- When we traffic-shift models (hosted/dedicated/private), the sidecar cascade gives a graceful downgrade path (primary -> quantized -> fallback).
- Quiet windows reduce noise in telemetry so we can see real regressions instead of background churn.
- This doc is intentionally pragmatic: checklist items that an on-call or release shepherd can run through in ~15-25 min preflight.

Scope for this run (nov 2025 mini-cascade):
- Services: api-proxy, model-router, KV cache, batching-worker, metrics-proxy
- Regions: us-west1 primary, us-east1 mirror (warm), eu-west1 passive
- Models: text-gen-v3 (primary), text-gen-v3-quant (quantized fallback), text-gen-compat (CPU fallback)
- Release owner: @ava.chen (eng-release)

Preflight quick checklist (do in order):
- [ ] Read the rollout brief in Confluence (INF-ARCH-466) and link to release notes draft.
- [ ] Confirm reserved capacity on Dedicated pool: confirm 3x baseline qps headroom (Slack #capacity-alerts).
- [ ] Validate PKI certs for sidecar TLS rotation: cert expiry > 90 days.
- [ ] Run smoke-suite locally against staging router (script: infra/release/smoke_sidecar.sh).
- [ ] Confirm KV cache warm-up script run completed (check job: infra-job-885, finished OK).
- [ ] Check metrics sampling config: ensure quiet-window sampling rate applied (metrics-proxy -> sampling=0.05).
- [ ] Tag the canary traffic group in the router (label: cascade/minicanary/2025-11-20).
- [ ] Inform CS and SRE 60m prior (post message to #release-alerts and ping @oncall).
- [ ] Create rollback ticket skeleton (JIRA: JIRA-INF-ROLL-2025-11-20) and include quick rollback commands.

Quiet-window matrix (apply per-service):
- api-proxy: 00:00-02:00 UTC (quiet=true, sampling=0.02)  -- reason: low product traffic, easier signal
- model-router: 00:00-04:00 UTC (quiet=true, prefix-cache-only sampling)
- batching-worker: 00:00-06:00 UTC (quiet=false, but enable detailed tracing for first 30 min)
- metrics-proxy: 00:00-06:00 UTC (quiet-override=on)
Notes: if any external integration (payments/thirdparty), shorten quiet window and notify those teams explicitly.

Sidecar cascade step-by-step (commands + checks):
1) Enable canary route (5% traffic to text-gen-v3-quant)
   - command: curl -XPOST https://router-admin/set-route -d '{"route":"cascade/minicanary","variant":"quant","pct":5}'
   - check: router/route-status cascade/minicanary -> quant=5% (wait until router metrics show 5% steady for 3m)
2) Monitor: latency p50/p95, error-rate, token-loss, truncation events for 15m
   - dashboards: /dashboards/latency-cascade, /dashboards/error-cascade
3) If metrics stable, increase to 25% over 10m steps
4) At 50% hold for 30m and run the functional prompts checklist (see "functional-smoke" below)
5) If anything regresses, flip percent back to previous and triage; if severe, run rollback (see fallback commands)

Functional-smoke (copyable prompts for CS & QA to run):
- prompt A: short-completion -> expect <20 tokens, response should contain product-keyword: "summary"
- prompt B: long context -> ensure no KV-cache misses > 2%
- prompt C: tool-call stub -> returns correct JSON schema and no latency > 2s
(attach results in the release ticket)

Rollforward and rollback snippets (keep these handy):
- increase route: POST /router-admin/increment?route=cascade/minicanary&to=25
- scale back: POST /router-admin/set-route -d '{"route":"cascade/minicanary","variant":"primary","pct":100}'
- emergency rollback (all to CPU fallback): POST /router-admin/set-route -d '{"route":"cascade/global","variant":"text-gen-compat","pct":100}'
- fast-disable streaming on proxy: kubectl -n prod scale deployment api-proxy --replicas=0 (used in worst-case; coordinate with SRE)

Rollout calendar (compact):
- T-72h: finalize release notes draft, link PRs and docs, add to confluence brief. Owner: @ava.chen
- T-24h: capacity confirm, smoke-suite pass on staging, CS notif (channel + email). Owner: @riley.kumar
- T-2h: quiet-window config push and verify sampling (metrics team)
- T-0: start 5% -> 25% -> 50% cadence, monitor 24m checkpoint cadence
- T+1h: collect functional-smoke results, prod release notes update
- T+24h: automated regression scan (eval harness), if pass mark release final

Release notes (draft – copyable):
- Release name: mini-cascade-textgen-2025-11-20
- Summary: Gradual rollout of text-gen-v3 quantized sidecar cascade to improve tail latency and reduce GPU cost for steady workloads. Initial rollout limited to us-west1 with mirror regions warm.
- Impact: No API surface changes. Expected lower p95 for bursty workloads and ~12% GPU token cost reduction on quantized path. Possible transient increase in tokenization latency during early cache warm-up.
- Rollback plan: Immediate revert to primary variant (commands in release ticket) or full fallback to text-gen-compat CPU path.
- Notes for support: If customers report truncated responses or schema mismatch, collect sample request/response and escalate to eng-serving-runtime.

Post-launch verification (first 6 hours):
- [ ] Validate p50 and p95 vs baseline (should be same or better).
- [ ] Verify error-rate < 0.5% and no upticks in 5xx/timeout.
- [ ] KV-cache hitrate >= baseline - 2% after 45m
- [ ] No increase in truncated responses > 0.1%
- [ ] Confirm billing/usage reporting behaving (cost estimates within expected range)

Open questions / TODOs:
- Do we include eu-west1 in the initial 25% step or keep passive until +24h? (ask product: @sofia)
- Can metrics team temporarily increase retention for this run by 48h? Need confirmation (tickets #MET-2025).
- Add a short note in the postmortem template about quiet-window effects on anomaly detection (small perf regressions vs signal suppression).

Quick links and breadcrumbs:
- Confluence brief: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INF-ARCH-466
- Router admin docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ROUTER-ADMIN
- Smoke script: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/blob/main/release/smoke_sidecar.sh
- Triage channel: #release-alerts (mention @oncall and @sre-lead)

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep the first quiet-window short if product wants to watch eu-west metrics; better to see a true baseline before long suppression.
- If batching-worker tracing is noisy, toggle detailed trace only for the canary pods (label=trace=canary).
- Save screenshots of dashboards at each step and paste into JIRA-INF-4213.

End of doc.
